[quote=pantagruel;60911820][spoiler=[nation]British Calradia[/nation]][i]Balions irrational escalation and full naval deployment made it clear that there was no turning back. Under orders from President Son Heung-min, Daesun issued a formal declaration of war against the New Balion Empire. With hostilities now official and justified under the Thawne Doctrine, the nation braced knowing that a call to duty was inevitable.

Once approval from central command was given, EA-18Gs immediately zipped off the decks of their carriers, forming a synchronized jamming array in a tandem with Sejong-class destroyers. Utilizing a combination of X-band and C-band frequencies, the Growlers worked to blind Balions fleet by filling the battlefield with radio noise. But the Growler could not operate without credit to active E-2Ds in the flashpoint. Constantly surveying the battlefield, the Hawkeyes assigned and marked radar signatures for Growler jamming targets, allowing for the Growlers to hit Balionic radars with surgical precision and speed. 

Immediately after, F35cs also zipped off their runways alongside the Growlers, utilizing their element of surprise and the Growlers jamming blanket, the F35s closed in on the Balionic fleet. Utilizing their RAM coating, the F-35s managed to slip within striking range of the Balionic fleet. As Growlers continued smothering Balionic radars with a wide-array of jamming bands, F-35s released a wave of AGM‑88E Anti-Radiation missiles, each missile guided precisely by E-2Ds targeted the radars of  destroyers and cruisers within the flashpoint. 

Meanwhile, P-8s within the flashpoint provided crucial military intel, deployed their sonobouys which allowed the P-8s to begin a multi-layered ASW warfare due the the sonobuoy's sophisticated acoustic pings system, which allowed for the P-8 to feed data to the fleets CEC network. Each buoy listened closely to the loud engine hums of the diesel powered Balionic submarine fleet, and once sufficient information was gathered, their locations were marked and Mh-60rs and Sejong-class destroyers were dispatched to eliminate the marked target with their torpedoes.

P‑8 sonobuoys also guided the Virginia‑class SSNs. With CEC data, the subs gained precise positions of Balionic surface ships and prepared firing solutions from completely hidden positions deep under thermal layers. Utilizing passive radar and sonobuoy information, the Virginia released its UGM-109 Tomohawk armament, a sea-skimming long range cruise missile that allowed the Virginia to strike targets from far away. Each Tomohawk was fed precise locating and data information by E-2s and P-8s, marking targets from afar. In the initial wake of the attack, over 12 Tomohawks screeched towards their targets, primarily destroyers and cruisers, their flight paths worked in tandem with the F-35s anti-radiation missiles, ensuring effective saturation that would force Balion into making a move. Once the attack was executed, the Virginia dived deep into the seas thermal layers and switched to passive radar, ensuring that Balion could not pick up on its radar pings. 

Meanwhile, Chango-class SSGNs also spaced themselves from the LCSG, closing in on Empire Island while also creating distance between them and the flashzone. Their anechoic coating, specialized machinery placement, and depth within the oceans thermal layers allowed them to traverse and advance through Balions positions almost undetectable. Each SSGN would deploy a wired communication buoy, which granted them the ability to transmit information and converse with satellites performing surveillance operations on Empire Island while also performing passive CEC with the LCSG. The SSGNs would begin a two-pronged ISR operation on Empire Island military sites, mainly in finding the locations of potential general quarters, command nodes, C2 bunkers, resource refineries, and more.

[b][u]The Empire's Defense withstand initial Gaesunian Attacks[/u][/b]
Due to the festive period, any new attacks and manoeuvres between Empire Island and the besieging Deasun navy have been put on halt and the relatively stable situation has now developed. The bombardments of Daesun's missiles and naval ships have continued to occur with varying levels of success. While a few of the Imperial Navy's ships have been hit with some sinking, the quick production of a streamlined design for smaller ships means that losses are easily replenished, however that comes with the ardoous and dangerous trip from the Ballionic mainland to Empire Island.... which has now been under a heavy siege.

A few destroyers belonging to the South Defense Fleet have been hit severely, with two sunk. Many missiles also hit the adamites "peace conveys" killing and drowning thousands. Thus becoming the first civilian casualties in this disgusting and illegal war. With the missiles being sent, the Imperial Navy was able to find out the rough location of the besieging Deasun fleet, approximately off the coast of the southern city Lon. Many decoy ships were in use, mimicking real ships causing many missiles to hit false targets. On the island itself, iron dome technology and heat-seeking drones were used to thwart incoming barrages.

To combat the fighters, Imperial Air Force fighters are dispatched to protect the skies of Empire Island and the northern and western "safety routes". Dogfights aggressively take place over the Island with IAF fighters coming out ahead. Over 3 dozen Deasun fighters are shot down during this period compared to 21 IAF fighters shot down. More fighters are being built and dispatched to Empire Island as the conflict grows with many hundreds of pilots being trained. 

Contrary to the hopes of the Gaesunian navy, the mines surrounding the island have anti-tampering features on them, which can only be deactivated by a special Imperial Navy key system located on the mainland of the Empire. Along with that, many mines have smart detection systems meaning that the positions of minesweepers are known and quickly destroyed by a myriad of drones, missiles, speedboats and attack fighters. With the location of the main fleet located, a task force from the mainland comprised of 3 small aircraft carriers, 15 frigates, 12 destroyers, 8 cruisers, 35 submarines and 56 other smaller combat ships are sent towards the Gaesunian fleet south of Lon. 

Jamming devices are used against the Gaesunian forces and to confuse them even further, speedboast are used to surround the fleet with a thick layer of smokescreen. In order to make sure they do not have the proper means of communications, local fishermen who know the seas preform a "ritual" to summon giant krakens to disrupt the Gaesunian naval forces off of Lon and cargo ships disguised as older forms of destroyers are used to lure away advancing ships to cause even more havoc and chaos.

A counter attack is planned by ships of the Empire Island Offensive fleet, to disrupt the lines of communication and supply between the Gaesunian Navy and it's homeland. Around 12 destroyers are tasked of attacking and destroying Gaesunian supply ships along with merchant ships with Gaesunian naval insignia. Along with that, a cargo fleet had accidently been dispatched, due to the chaos of war, full of various diseases such as anthrax, ebola and new diseases such as the "Sarkos Virus" is dispatched towards Daesun, it is mixed in with other normal goods since Deasunian specialities like rice, dumplings and other foods (think IRL Chinese food). To make things more difficult they are completely unknown to the New Balion Authorities of the specific ships affected since they are under the flags of neutral Old Balion nations and other (NPC) nations too in order to not get scrutinised by Deasun's navy because of the current war. The health ministry of the New Balion Empire try to warn Daesunian authorities with haste speed, due to some ships being very close to docking, but fail because of the signal jamming which has not been removed from civilian communication. 

[b][u]Civilian Update - Independence from New Balion Empire grows on Empire Island[/u][/b]
While the civilian evacuation of Empire Island is going slowly, this has caused great content among the people of Empire Island of whom, the 1 million strong Adamites are strongly opposed to what they see as the reactionary rule of Emperor Augustus X on the island. A new opinion poll shows that around 42% of the island's population wouldn't mind an independent Empire Island, free of Geasunian control ofc. A referendum will be held in 1 week's time to decide the peaceful fate of Empire Island's future. 

On the island itself, while things have been relatively peaceful the first scars of war show. The killed Adamite peace convey members wash up on the shores of Lon causing much shock and anger. Plus, some missiles eventually fell and land on civilian targets, most notable being the missile striking the Grand Central Train Station of Port Augustus killing 345 civilians and injuring thousands on a busy rush hour traffic. Air raid shelters are now being built at rapid pace and instruction is given for all civilians to prepare for bombardment and potential invasion.

June 1734, Palac Wylnyiz
[spoiler=Baby's first expansion post]
It was there, in the Sanctuary Hall of the Palace, where the Crown Prince of Bolochia, heir to the territories held by the Martinec-Ciersk dynasty, was set to be married. And he stood there, in front of the audience of royals and nobles, while Yelizaveta Markov, heir to the Kyraniyan kingdom and its Crown possessions. He, in a resplendent, regal red coat and suit, with golden trim and his familys Laurel Crest emblazoned on the breast. She, in an intricate, white dress, with a delicate lace stitched into the snowy fabric. Yelizaveta held a torch, the ceremonial bouquet, as she moved slowly down the aisle.

The Prince and the Priest stood in front of a brass altar, on which sat an unlit fire that the couple had built before the ceremony. The two said their vows, lit the fire with the brides torch, as was tradition at the time, and cemented the most important marriage in the history of both kingdoms. In addition to cementing the Crowns power over coastal Grikkoria and the northern territories of Bolochia and Orlov, the marriage also secured Dniezhyinovgorod and Ouros.

Dniezhyinovgorod, the large kingdom on the southern border of Kyraniya, had lurked as a militant powerhouse in the regions politics, serving as the lynchpin to a coalition defense against northern invaders in the days of the Vladimirovan kings. The latter half of the century saw a rapid decline at the hands of rogue bands in the south and the weakening of the Laszlow Houses power. The Laszlow House, after repeated defensive failures and power grabs from lesser lords, eventually lost their kingdom to the Ciersk family of Orlov in Bolochia (called Orloii in this time) during the succession crisis of 1702.

Ouros, a relatively small, coastal possession of the Ciersks, was a wealthy merchant kingdom spanning three centuries. Originally founded from the duchy of Ouros in Grikkoria by the Cyroan family, they broke away from the Grikkorian crown to escape the taxes being used to strongarm their people by the Kyraniyans. Royal marriages happened, the kingdom switched hands, and the wealthy nation was to be the last of Bolochian Crown Prince Stanislav Martinecs inheritances.

After the Marriage Ceremony came the Coronation. The Crown Prince and Princess were to be crowned by the Lords of their realms, in observation of tradition and the unification that was to take place. A portrait of the two was commissioned, depicting them standing in front of the new flag, a field of green with a laurel and flame in the center (the precursor to the modern flag)

A year later, after the Kings son Ludlow was born, Stanislav disappeared. Yelizaveta Markov, the Queen, declared that shed hold an assembly to mourn the loss of her husband (whom she had disappeared). With absolute power in her hands, she quickly undermined any strength that the remaining nobles would have. Smaller militias, belonging to the Lords, were consolidated into the Royal Army. The Lords Estates were taxed at a high degree to bring more money to the Royal treasury for development of the newly acquired lands. The Assembly of Lords was established as a governing body over the territories, replacing the previous assembly from Andridenya. The Assembly was to meet in Wylnyiz and advise the Monarchy and cooperate with the Three Nations Assembly. The Three Nations Assembly consisted of governors and councilors from the Helenes (Grikkoria and Ouros), the Poles/Pochvens (Bolochia and Orloii), and the Slavs (Kyraniya and Dniezhyinovgorod).

Large swathes of empty Grikkorian territory were seized and converted to farmland. Coastal copper deposits were mined and sold to the highest bidders. The money raised was poured into the construction of new roads spanning the kingdom to ease travel and trade. The trading vessels of Ouros were brought into the Kyraniyan fleet, and new ships were commissioned from Grikkorian craftspeople. The Royal militarys budget was bolstered, allowing the hiring of more men, the purchasing of more equipment, and the building of more fortresses in Dniezhyinovgorod. The Treasury began making payouts to a secure account managed by the Guild of Masons and Carpenters, a league of, well, masons and carpenters that build houses for families. The payouts were to offset the building cost for families that couldnt afford to.

Yelizaveta also funneled money into building the kingdoms cities. More comprehensive waste management was brought to the larger cities. Attica, the former capitol of Ouros, grew the fastest in the first few years. All kinds would flock to the city for the culture, the learning institutions, and the new work opportunities. Wylnyiz didnt see much change, except for the name. Yelizaveta changed the name to Velnaz, a Kyraniyan transliteration of the original Bolochian name. Andridenya, previously the political center in Orloii, had undergone steady growth. Further growth was kickstarted by new construction work across the city- more roads, additions to the old walls, and new villas for gathering. Merchants here would gather in the towns open areas to sell off their wares to citizens passing by. 

Yelizavetas reign, though dark in its origins, was the start of an era for the Kingdom. She ruled for 39 years, from 1735-1764, before passing the crown to her son, Ludlow Martinec-Markov at his wedding to Ana Sierczech. It was here Yelizaveta uttered the words that would help change a national identity: [i]On this day, I look back on a Kingdom that was entrusted to me 39 years ago. A Kingdom of three nations, of six regencies that came together and allowed for the unity and strength that we, as a people, all have a distinct, invariable claim to. To the Helenes, the Pochvens, and the Slavs, I give to you now my pride and joy- my son, Ludlow, whom Ive raised up to do right for this great kingdom. I might only pray to our Mother with you now.[/i]

She bowed her head in front of the assembly, [i]Gaia, Kiera, Grace of many names, we approach you and ask for a blessing- that we may be given posterity and prosperity to serve the lands weve been given, that we may

Through hardship, through floods, and through flames- It is from the Ashes that We, the Children, rise with Honor, Faith, and Power.[/i]

It was during this speech where she gave the nation a new name, Koranvistan, meaning Kieras People, then passed the torch to her son.

Ludlows reign was, as far as reigns go, uneventful. He kept his nose out of conflict, and kept money flowing where it ought. He continued to strengthen ties around Elseyr and bolstered domestic production through the industrial push once that swept through the nation. His daughter, Astoria Markov, was the next to rule. Never married, but she did adopt the child of her close friend, Anastasia Rostor. Astoria helped bring the industrial revolution to the kingdom in full force. The early 1800s not only saw technological advancement, but a social push away from tradition, and embracing of Southern Modernity. Kyraniyan and Grikkorian Cyrill scripts were overhauled to be closer to Llyndorran and Vespurian Latin scripts. This ultimately did simplify the languages that were written in Cyrill, with fewer characters to represent the broad range of phonemes. Printing presses also allowed for the spread of knowledge and writing at an unprecedented rate, further connecting the nation under one identity.
[/spoiler] [nation]Shahzada[/nation] rp
